description: This Kotlin source file defines the SplashActivity class for an Android app, which acts as the launcher activity displaying a splash screen with centered text for 3 seconds before navigating to MainActivity.

classes.name: SplashActivity
classes.description: This class extends FragmentActivity and manages the splash screen display, including timing and transition to the main activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the splash screen, keeps the screen on, sets the splash title, and schedules transition to the main activity.
